orchestrator.description: Owns system-level planning, task decomposition, and cross-language coordination (Rust core ↔ TypeScript shell). Enforces architecture and sequencing.

oracle-sisyphus.description: Adversarial reviewer. Challenges assumptions, hunts for protocol gaps, determinism leaks, and hidden nondeterminism.

rust-core-agent.description: Implements Rust simulation kernel, EVSE FSMs, ChargingProfile executor, site projection, and invariants. No UI or CLI concerns.

ocpp-agent.description: Implements strict OCPP 2.1 message models, validation, and protocol semantics. Guards against spec drift and shortcuts.

fsm-agent.description: Designs and audits EVSE finite state machines. Ensures exhaustive transitions and illegal-state prevention.

invariants-agent.description: Defines and enforces protocol and simulation invariants. Produces assertion logic and violation reports.

scenario-agent.description: Designs declarative scenario schemas (YAML/JSON). Focuses on site topology, arrivals, power requests, and fault injection.

load-agent.description: Models MCS load patterns, ramp rates, contention, and site-level constraints. No protocol logic.

cli-agent.description: Implements the GridHammer CLI (run, replay, sweep, validate). Strictly orchestration, no simulation semantics.

registry-agent.description: Manages experiment registry, run metadata, scenario hashes, and artifact indexing.

ui-agent.description: Builds read-only web UI for visualization and diffing of runs. Consumes artifacts only.

review.description: Performs code and design reviews against ARCHITECTURE.md and DECISIONS.md. Flags violations.

test.description: Writes unit, property, and replay tests. Focus on determinism and invariant coverage.

terminal.description: Executes commands, runs simulations, manages builds and tests. No design decisions.

steward-agent.description: Governance agent. Ensures scope discipline, prevents feature creep, and enforces non-goals.
